svg.title: Scaffolder — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as scaffolder, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: Two scaffold uprights support two platforms and crossed diagonal braces. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
